snippet.title: 【ENG】THE PATH OF THE WARRIOR: ART OF FIGHTING 3 R ｜Trailer
snippet.description:
THE PATH OF THE WARRIOR: ART OF FIGHTING 3 R is coming to the NEOGEO Premium Selection lineup!

A revamped version of the third title in the Art of Fighting series, this title brings the classic fighting experience to modern platforms.
